name: Cross Cut
description: A diagonal stroke drawn from shoulder to hip, the first cut every novice of the Order learns in the Birgu yards. Hits a little harder than a plain strike.

name: Pilgrim's Thrust
description: A straight lunge aimed at the seams between plates, taught to knights who walked to Jerusalem and back. Pierces part of the target's DEF.

name: Shieldbreaker
description: Both arms of the armatura drive one crushing blow down onto the foe's guard. Tires the target.

name: Eight-Point Flurry
description: Two cuts traced like the arms of the eight-pointed cross, one rising and one falling. Strikes twice for lighter damage each, is accurate and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Stoccata Lunga
description: A long, precise lunge in the Italian manner, learned in the fencing hall of the Auberge of Italy. Hits hard and is very accurate.

name: Last Rampart
description: A great two-handed overhead blow delivered as if holding the last breach at St Elmo. Hits very hard and tires the target. Only medium or heavy frames carry its weight.

name: Shield Bash
description: The shield boss is rammed forward into the enemy's chest plate before they can set their feet. Cannot be countered.

name: Rim Strike
description: The shield rim snaps up under the chin of the enemy's helm. Tires the target.

name: Bell-Ringer
description: A swinging mace blow to the helm that sets the whole harness ringing like the bells of San Lorenzo. Tires the target.

name: Helm Splitter
description: A flanged mace brought down on the crest of a helmet with a woodsman's swing. Hits hard and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Knell of Saint John
description: One toll of the great bell of the Conventual Church, made flesh in iron. Hits very hard and tires the target.

name: Hedge of Pikes
description: The pike is levelled and held firm, a single point standing for a whole Spanish square. Cannot be countered.

name: Lance of Aragon
description: A short galloping rush with the polearm couched under the arm, in the manner of Aragonese jousters. Reaches two tiles.

name: Halberd Hook
description: The hook behind the halberd blade catches a belt or a stirrup and drags the target off balance. Hits hard, tires the target, cannot be countered and reaches two tiles.

name: Knight's Charge
description: The full weight of a medium armatura behind a lowered polearm, boilers roaring. Hits hard, pierces part of the target's DEF and reaches two tiles. Only medium frames carry its weight.

name: Charge of the Langues
description: Knights of every Langue lower their lances together and ride as one body. Hits very hard, tires the target and reaches two tiles. Only medium frames carry its weight.

name: Fisherman's Hook-Cut
description: A sharp curling cut learned gutting fish on the Marsaxlokk quays. Hits a little harder than a plain strike.

name: Żejtun Feint
description: A false step to one side, then two short cuts from the other, a trick of the Żejtun lanes. Strikes twice for lighter damage each, is accurate and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Harvest Swing
description: A wide sweeping cut swung like a sickle through the summer wheat. Tires the target.

name: Carob Split
description: A full overhead chop with the strength used to split carob logs. Hits very hard.

name: Last Stand
description: No retreat is left, so no part of the body is spared in the swing. Hits very hard and tires the target.

name: Pitchfork Jab
description: A quick two-handed jab with the polearm from behind a field wall. Reaches two tiles.

name: Brace and Drive
description: The butt is planted against the limestone and the point driven home as the foe comes on. Cannot be countered and reaches two tiles.

name: Watchtower Sweep
description: A broad low sweep of the polearm, as the coastal watch fends off landing parties. Hits hard, tires the target and reaches two tiles.

name: Gaff Hook
description: A fisherman's gaff dragged across the enemy's footing. Hits hard, tires the target, cannot be countered and reaches two tiles.

name: Wallbreaker
description: A long spear driven into the head of a scaling ladder and heaved back. Hits very hard, tires the target and reaches two tiles.

name: Aimed Shot
description: A slow, careful shot, matchlock braced and breath held until the moment is right. Pierces part of the target's DEF.

name: Double Charge
description: The arquebus is loaded with a double measure of powder and ball, risking the barrel. Hits hard.

name: Crossfire
description: Two quick shots from alternating firing positions behind the bastion parapet. Strikes twice for lighter damage each, is accurate and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Braced Shot
description: The arquebus is laid on the parapet wall and the shot taken on the breath. Hits hard and pierces part of the target's DEF.

name: Sharpshooter
description: A patient shot aimed at the vision slit or a boiler joint. Hits very hard and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Crescent Slash
description: A curving draw-cut that follows the line of the kilij's blade. Hits a little harder than a plain strike.

name: Drawing Cut
description: The yatagan's curve slides through the target's guard in a single pulling stroke. Is accurate.

name: Janissary's Oath
description: A heavy overhead cut delivered with the full discipline of the Sultan's household infantry. Hits hard.

name: Twin Moons
description: Two crescent cuts in quick succession, one high and one low. Strikes twice for lighter damage each, is accurate and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Sultan's Edge
description: A perfect drawing slash reserved for veterans in medium frames, aimed at joints and seams. Hits very hard and tires the target. Only medium frames carry its weight.

name: Steady Volley
description: A measured tüfek shot fired from a braced stance, as drilled in the ortas. Hits a little harder than a plain strike.

name: Rolling Fire
description: Two shots in quick succession, a second barrel or a fast reload. Strikes twice for lighter damage each, is accurate and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Tufek Salvo
description: Two ranks fire as one and the powder-smoke closes in around the target. Hits hard and tires the target.

name: Marksman of the Orta
description: A long-barrelled tüfek shot laid carefully on a weak point. Hits hard and pierces part of the target's DEF.

name: Fire Line of the Orta
description: The whole orta fires in order, rank behind rank. Strikes twice for lighter damage each, is very accurate and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Lance Feint
description: The lance tip dips as if to strike low, then darts high. Cannot be countered and reaches two tiles.

name: Sipahi Charge
description: A light armatura sweeps in at speed with lance lowered, in the manner of the provincial cavalry. Reaches two tiles. Only light frames carry its weight.

name: Hooked Spear Pull
description: A hooked lance-head catches the strap of a shield and tears it away. Hits hard, tires the target, cannot be countered and reaches two tiles.

name: Akinji Sweep
description: The raiders of the frontier sweep their lances low across a line of men. Hits hard, tires the target and reaches two tiles.

name: Thunder of Hooves
description: Light frames gallop in at full speed and drive the lance through. Hits very hard, tires the target and reaches two tiles. Only light frames carry its weight.

name: Fire Pot
description: A clay pot of burning naphtha is hurled to burst against the target's plates. Hits a little harder than a plain strike.

name: Smoke and Iron
description: A bomb packed with iron scraps and thick smoke is lobbed at the foe. Tires the target.

name: Humbara Cluster
description: Two clay grenades from one hand, the second hard on the first. Strikes twice for lighter damage each, pierces about half of the target's DEF and tires the target.

name: Burning Pitch
description: A cask of blazing pitch is flung to coat the armatura in fire. Badly tires the target.

name: Tophane Barrage
description: The gunners of the Tophane arsenal lob a hail of fire-pots. Strikes twice for lighter damage each, pierces about half of the target's DEF and badly tires the target.

name: Boarding Slash
description: A quick cut delivered while leaping across a galley's rail. Hits a little harder than a plain strike.

name: Deck Dance
description: Two light cuts made while dancing across a pitching deck. Strikes twice for lighter damage each, is accurate and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Salt and Steel
description: A wide sweeping cut flung with the swing of a ship's boom. Hits hard and tires the target.

name: Cutlass Storm
description: A flurry of cutlass work in the confusion of a boarding. Strikes twice for lighter damage each, is very accurate, pierces about half of the target's DEF and tires the target.

name: Barbary Reaper
description: A whirling full-body sweep of the blade, the signature of the Barbary raiders. Hits very hard and tires the target.

name: Boat-Hook Jab
description: A short jab with the boat-hook, the same motion used to fend a boat off a quay. Hits a little harder than a plain strike.

name: Grapple
description: An iron hook is thrown into the target's plates and hauled tight. Cannot be countered.

name: Keelhaul
description: The armatura is hooked and wrenched off balance, then driven into the ground. Hits hard and tires the target.

name: Harpoon Thrust
description: A whaler's thrust that bites deep behind the plates. Hits hard, pierces part of the target's DEF and reaches two tiles.

name: Drowning Hook
description: The hook sets in the armour and the target is dragged down like a catch hauled overboard. Hits very hard, tires the target and cannot be countered.

name: Piston Strike
description: A steam piston fires the fist forward with a hiss and a crack. Hits a little harder than a plain strike.

name: Valve Release
description: A hiss of steam into the joints just before the blow lands. Tires the target.

name: Steam Hammer
description: Valves open fully and the arm falls like a forge hammer. Hits hard and tires the target.

name: Governor Slam
description: A governor wheel spun up to speed and released into the blow. Hits hard and pierces part of the target's DEF.

name: Overpressure
description: The boiler is pushed beyond its safe limit for one shattering blow. Hits very hard and tires the target.

name: Rivet Shot
description: A rivet gun pressed into service as a weapon: accurate, and it pierces a little of the target's DEF. Pierces part of the target's DEF.

name: Grapeshot
description: A charge of grapeshot is fired from a hull-mounted gun. Strikes twice for lighter damage each, is accurate and pierces about half of the target's DEF.

name: Siege Bolt
description: A heavy iron bolt is driven from a steam launcher. Hits hard and pierces part of the target's DEF.

name: Chain Shot
description: Two linked balls on a chain that tear through rigging and plate. Strikes twice for lighter damage each, is accurate, pierces about half of the target's DEF and tires the target.

name: Full Broadside
description: Every gun on a heavy machine fires at once in a single roar. Strikes twice for lighter damage each, is very accurate, pierces about half of the target's DEF and tires the target. Only heavy frames carry its weight.
